Describe a dossier

Where the two versions come from and which code to run. Nothing is fetched or run until the stages below.

dossier()

Run it

Each stage caches its work in the work folder; run_dossier() calls them all.

run_dossier()
Make a dossier in one call
prepare_versions()
Fetch, build and install both versions
run_scenarios()
Run the scenarios under both versions
compare_runs()
Compare the runs and label every difference

Write the comparison as a standalone HTML report
write_dossier_json()
Write the comparison as JSON
write_dossier_md()
Write the comparison as a short Markdown summary

accept_differences()

check_differences()
Stop when differences nobody accepted remain
